element (for a 2D grid: 4 neighbors)\nconstexpr int MAX_CONNECTIONS = 8;\n\n// Material properties for energy transfer\nstruct Material {\n    val_t transfer_coeff;  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n elements_static;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic_swap;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root) {\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n    \n    // Allocate elements\n    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(n_elems);\n    \n    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy\n    for (int i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        world.elements_static[i].num_connections = 0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n            \n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n            \n            for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is within bounds\n                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {\n                    const int neighbor_idx = nx * n_elems_root + ny;\n                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;\n                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                    elem.num_connections++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics\n    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two elements\ninline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, const ElementDynamic& this_elem,\n                        val_t connection_flux, const ElementDynamic& other_elem) {\n    return (other_elem.current_energy - this_elem.current_energy) * \n           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        // Update all elements\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n            const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n            const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[i];\n            const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n            \n            // Start with external flow\n            val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;\n            \n            // Add flux from all connected elements\n            for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n                const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n                const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[neighbor_idx];\n                total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn, elem_static.connected_flux[j], neighbor_dyn);\n            }\n            \n            // Update element state\n            ElementDynamic& elem_write = world.elements_dynamic_swap[i];\n            elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n            elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);\n        }\n        \n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate simulation results\nbool validateResults(const World& world) {\n    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    \n    for (const auto& elem : world.elements_dynamic) {\n        energy_sum += elem.current_energy;\n        flux_sum += elem.total_flux;\n        energy_max = std::max(elem.current_energy, energy_max);\n        energy_min = std::min(elem.current_energy, energy_min);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Validation results:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Energy sum: %.12f\\n\", energy_sum);\n    printf(\"  Flux sum: %.2f\\n\", flux_sum);\n    printf(\"  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", energy_min, energy_max);\n    \n    // Check for numerical issues\n    constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;\n    \n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    if (std::abs(energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\\n\");\n        // Don't fail validation as this can happen with external flows\n    }\n    \n    if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Compute a simple hash of the results for verification\nuint64_t computeHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < elements.size(); ++i) {\n        // Simple hash combining energy and flux values\n        const uint64_t* e_ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint64_t*>(&elements[i].current_energy);\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Grid size (NxN Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int n_elems_root = 512;\n    int n_iters = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n_elems_root = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n_iters = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    printf(\"Unstructured Mesh Energy Transfer Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"============================================\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %d x %d = %d elements\\n\", n_elems_root, n_elems_root, n_elems);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", n_iters);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : // Calculate memory usage\n    const size_t static_mem = world.elements_static.size() * sizeof(ElementStatic);\n    const size_t dynamic_mem = world.elements_dynamic.size() * sizeof(ElementDynamic) * idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\n\n// World state\nstruct World {\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic_swap;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root) {\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n    \n    // Allocate elements\n    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(n_elems);\n    \n    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy\n    for (int i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        world.elements_static[i].num_connections = 0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n            \n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n            \n            for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is within bounds\n                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {\n                    const int neighbor_idx = nx * n_elems_root + ny;\n                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;\n                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                    elem.num_connections++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics\n    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two elements\ninline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, const ElementDynamic& this_elem,\n                        val_t connection_flux, const ElementDynamic& other_elem) {\n    return (other_elem.current_energy - this_elem.current_energy) * \n           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        // Update all elements\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n            const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n            const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[i];\n            const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n element state\n            ElementDynamic& elem_write = world.elements_dynamic_swap[i];\n            elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n }\n}\n\n// Validate simulation results\nbool validateResults(const World& world) {\n    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t energy_max = Jacobi-style update step: each thread computes one element.\n// Reads from the \"in\" buffers and writes to the \"out\" buffers, so all\n// elements observe the previous iteration's state (no data }\n\n    // Host staging for dynamic state (SoA)\n    std::vector<val_t> h_energy(n_elems), h_flux(n_elems);\n    std::vector<val_t> h_energy_swap(n_elems), h_flux_swap(n_elems);\n    for (int i = 0; *d_energy[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    val_t *d_flux[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_materials, world.materials.size() * sizeof(Material)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_mat_idx, n * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_num_conn, n * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_conn_idx, static_cast<size_t>(max_conn) * n * world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = h_energy[i];\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = h_flux[i];\n        world.elements_dynamic_swap[i].current_energy = h_energy_swap[i];\n {"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1793116128249,"sessionID":"ses_e81f77c92ffeuR2TRUxGeNqfVI","part":{"id":"prt_17e0c648a001vYM0XLhxEFbBwo","messageID":"msg_17e0c5d6b001EOzYZvaG0sPu4W","sessionID":"ses_e81f77c92ffeuR2TRUxGeNqfVI","type":"reasoning","text":"Host-side staging is clearly the bottleneck—1.29s for static data and 0.5s for dynamic data, likely dominated by page faults from allocating and zero-initializing large multi-hundred-MB vectors before scattered writes populate them. I'm thinking about ways to avoid that upfront zero-initialization cost to cut down the staging time.\n\nI'm weighing options: skip zero-init on allocation (page faults still hit on first touch, roughly 200ms for 800MB), or write directly into device memory via pinned buffers, or restructure as a chunked streaming upload using a fixed pinned staging buffer with strided 2D memcpy to convert AoS to SoA layout on the fly, which seems like the better path despite added complexity.\n\nI'm also considering just uploading the raw static array as-is without SoA conversion, but that bloats device memory and kernel bandwidth at scale, so the chunked SoA approach still seems worth implementing given the performance and scalability requirements. I'll go with per-chunk pinned staging buffers feeding cudaMemcpy2D calls.\n\nFor the dynamic state, I'm weighing whether to keep AoS layout on the device entirely versus converting to SoA via a strided cudaMemcpy2D from the host's interleaved energy/flux array into separate device buffers — the latter avoids per-neighbor stride penalties in the kernel while still letting me reuse the same chunked pinned-buffer technique for the smaller 16-byte-per-element dynamic data.\n\nStill writing staging logic...\n\nPicking a chunk size of 256K elements keeps pinned staging buffers around 24MB, which is reasonable even with multiple concurrent connections. The setup cost of ~2.1s makes this pipelining worthwhile for maximum performance, and the inherent 2.3GB read from the source array is unavoidable overhead. Now I'm writing the simulation runner function...\n\nI'm reconsidering whether to simplify the staging buffers into one pinned allocation sliced into parts, or just skip pinned memory entirely and use pageable memory with synchronous copies for simplicity, accepting the bandwidth tradeoff.\n\nCalculating the actual upload volume per element (mat, nc, conn_idx, conn_flux totaling ~104 bytes) against 16M elements gives roughly 1.7GB total, and comparing pinned (~140ms) vs pageable (~280ms) transfer times convinces me pinned memory is worth the ~100ms savings, so I'll just use cudaMallocHost directly without a fallback since this is CUDA-only. Downloads only need the final energy/flux values per element, chunked as before.\n\nAs for the swap buffer, I realize its contents after the run are never observed — the program only reads elements_dynamic for hashing, printing, and validation, and since every element of the output buffer gets fully overwritten each iteration, there's no need to initialize, upload, or download the swap buffer at all. This simplifies things nicely: I can drop the swap buffer transfer entirely and just track the final \"cur\" buffer.\n\nNow I'm setting up pinned host staging buffers for chunked transfers — indices, flux values, material IDs, connection counts, and dynamic state — sized to a capped chunk of elements, allocated with cudaMallocHost, then writing a loop that packs static element data (material index, connection count, and padded connection indices) into these staged buffers before copying them to the device with a strided 2D memcpy per chunk.\n\nI'm deciding it's fine to leave unused connection slots uninitialized in the padded buffer since the kernel never reads past the valid count, so there's no need to waste cycles zeroing them. I'm also weighing whether material index and connection count should be stored as uint32 versus a smaller type like uint8 to save bandwidth, but leaning toward keeping uint32 for simplicity since the savings are negligible compared to the connection index data itself.\n\nFor the dynamic data, I'm restructuring the upload to use separate pinned staging arrays for energy and flux rather than interleaving them, then copying each into their respective device buffers in one batched memcpy per chunk. On the download side, I'm mirroring this by pulling energy and flux values back from whichever buffer is currently active after the kernel runs, then writing them directly into the corresponding fields of the elements_dynamic array on the host while leaving the rest of that struct untouched.\n\nFor replacing the runSimulation function, I decide the safest approach is to splice in the new implementation between two recognizable marker comments using a small Python script, rather than rewriting the whole file or trying to match a long unique string for an edit.\n\n","time":{"start":1793116103818,"end":1793116128229},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}
{"type":"text","timestamp":1793116128565,"sessionID":"ses_e81f77c92ffeuR2TRUxGeNqfVI","part":{"id":"prt_17e0cc3eb001p2Sv8KvrnDDVTM","messageID":"msg_17e0c5d6b001EOzYZvaG0sPu4W","sessionID":"ses_e81f77c92ffeuR2TRUxGeNqfVI","type":"text","text":"Setup is the bottleneck: host-side staging into large zeroed vectors takes about 1.3 s for connectivity plus about 0.5 s for dynamic state, and the device copies add more. Improvements:\n\n1. Stream the data in chunks through a small pinned staging buffer, using `cudaMemcpy2D` for the connectivity layout. This avoids giant host temporaries.\n2. Drop the swap-buffer transfer. Every element is fully rewritten each iteration, and `elements_dynamic_swap` is never read after `runSimulation`, so this changes no output.\n\nI'll write the new function to a scratch file and splice it into the source.","time":{"start":1793116128235,"end":1793116128558}}}
{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793116137438,"sessionID":"ses_e81f77c92ffeuR2TRUxGeNqfVI","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01Wqa9Ce5fi9EZ5TVrqYsD2d","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/new_run.cpp","content":"// Run simulation for n_iters iterations on the GPU.\n// Static connectivity and dynamic state are streamed to the device in chunks through\n// pinned staging buffers, all iterations run on the device with ping-pong buffers,\n// and the final state is streamed back into world.elements_dynamic.\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const int n_elems_i = static_cast<int>(world.elements_static.size());\n    if (n_elems_i == 0 || n_iters <= 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(n_elems_i);\n\n    // Padded connection-major layout: row j holds connection j of every element\n    uint32_t max_conn = 0;\n    for (const auto& elem : world.elements_static) {\n        max_conn = std::max(max_conn, static_cast<uint32_t>(elem.num_connections));\n    }\n    const size_t n_rows = std::max<size_t>(max_conn, 1);\n\n    // Device allocations\n    Material* d_materials = nullptr;\n    uint32_t *d_mat_idx = nullptr, *d_num_conn = nullptr, *d_conn_idx = nullptr;\n    val_t *d_conn_flux = nullptr;\n    val_t *d_energy[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    val_t *d_flux[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_materials, world.materials.size() * sizeof(Material)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_mat_idx, n * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_num_conn, n * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_conn_idx, n_rows * n * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_conn_flux, n_rows * n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_energy[b], n * sizeof(val_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_flux[b], n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    }\n\n    // Pinned staging buffers, reused for each chunk of elements\n    constexpr size_t CHUNK_ELEMS = size_t(1) << 18;\n    const size_t chunk_cap = std::min(n, CHUNK_ELEMS);\n    uint32_t *h_mat_stage = nullptr, *h_nc_stage = nullptr, *h_idx_stage = nullptr;\n    val_t *h_flux_stage = nullptr, *h_energy_stage = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_mat_stage, chunk_cap * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_nc_stage, chunk_cap * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_idx_stage, n_rows * chunk_cap * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_flux_stage, n_rows * chunk_cap * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_energy_stage, chunk_cap * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    // Upload materials\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_materials, world.materials.data(),\n                          world.materials.size() * sizeof(Material), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Upload static connectivity and initial dynamic state, chunk by chunk\n    for (size_t a = 0; a < n; a += chunk_cap) {\n        const size_t w = std::min(chunk_cap, n - a);\n\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < w; ++t) {\n            const ElementStatic& e = world.elements_static[a + t];\n            h_mat_stage[t] = static_cast<uint32_t>(e.material_idx);\n            h_nc_stage[t] = static_cast<uint32_t>(e.num_connections);\n            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < static_cast<uint32_t>(e.num_connections); ++j) {\n                h_idx_stage[j * w + t] = static_cast<uint32_t>(e.connected_idx[j]);\n                h_flux_stage[j * w + t] = e.connected_flux[j];\n            }\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_mat_idx + a, h_mat_stage, w * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_num_conn + a, h_nc_stage, w * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(d_conn_idx + a, n * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                                h_idx_stage, w * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                                w * sizeof(uint32_t), n_rows, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(d_conn_flux + a, n * sizeof(val_t),\n                                h_flux_stage, w * sizeof(val_t),\n                                w * sizeof(val_t), n_rows, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < w; ++t) {\n            h_energy_stage[t] = world.elements_dynamic[a + t].current_energy;\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_energy[0] + a, h_energy_stage, w * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < w; ++t) {\n            h_energy_stage[t] = world.elements_dynamic[a + t].total_flux;\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_flux[0] + a, h_energy_stage, w * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    constexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n    const int grid_size = static_cast<int>((n + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);\n\n    // Every element is fully written each iteration, so the second buffer needs no initial upload\n    int cur = 0;  // index of the buffer holding the current state\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        const int nxt = 1 - cur;\n        stepKernel<<<grid_size, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_materials, d_mat_idx, d_num_conn,\n                                              d_conn_idx, d_conn_flux,\n                                              n_elems_i, n_elems_i,\n                                              d_energy[cur], d_flux[cur],\n                                              d_energy[nxt], d_flux[nxt]);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        cur = nxt;  // swap buffers\n    }\n\n    // Download final state into world.elements_dynamic, chunk by chunk\n    for (size_t a = 0; a < n; a += chunk_cap) {\n        const size_t w = std::min(chunk_cap, n - a);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_energy_stage, d_energy[cur] + a, w * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < w; ++t) {\n            world.elements_dynamic[a + t].current_energy = h_energy_stage[t];\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_energy_stage, d_flux[cur] + a, w * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < w; ++t) {\n            world.elements_dynamic[a + t].total_flux = h_energy_stage[t];\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Release device and pinned host resources\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_materials));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_mat_idx));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_num_conn));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_conn_idx));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_conn_flux));\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_energy[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_flux[b]));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_mat_stage));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_nc_stage));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_idx_stage));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_flux_stage));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_energy_stage));\n}\n\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/new_run.cpp","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/new_run.cpp","time":{"start":1793116137379,"end":1793116137401}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17e0cc5320010Jmzwsk9X2WJj4","sessionID":"ses_e81f77c92ffeuR2TRUxGeNqfVI","messageID":"msg_17e0c5d6b001EOzYZvaG0sPu4W"}}
